rows.what_the_ink_shows: The argument of Gamma^* is a clear Psi: two open upper arms and a descending central stem, with no closed oval. It matches the Psi following Lambda^* on the same line. See crops/136_scan089_L324.jpg.
rows.note: L324.R1: the manuscript really writes Gamma^*(Psi), as the supplied evidence itself reports. The proposed Phi is a mathematical repair, not an optical correction. Resolve the actual original \unsure{\Psi|\Phi} at this disputed letter to the visible \Psi, retaining the author’s formula. The claims about which object it resolves and about other scans are not independently checked.

events.type: used and rechecked in this run
events.outcome: Compared the original Psi|Phi uncertainty against the enlarged formula. The open-armed Psi is clear, so the alternative is resolved to Psi without substituting the mathematically proposed Phi.

events.type: refuted, with the refined statement's id
events.outcome: L324.R1 refutes only the classification of Psi-to-Phi as a transcription correction: the visible letter is Psi. No independent mathematical refutation is claimed.
